summary: Amsterdam, Netherlands, technical background in software and hardware, strong interest in smartwatches (specifically Pebble), advocacy for free software and open-source principles, critical of corporate practices and consumer rights, engaged in discussions about political and social issues, interest in usability and user experience design, preference for sustainable technology (Fairphone), critical of advertising and its impact on society, views on whistleblowing and activism, family-oriented with a focus on practical technology use in daily life.
